title: May 20th Tornado - Moore, Okla.
description: Airmen from the 146th Air Support Operations Squadron help local state police forces control traffic in and around Moore, Okla. and provide search and rescue operations.
keywords: Oklahoma, Oklahoma National Guard, Moore, oklahoma tornado
